get_args_parse_all: parse all BERT training arguments including model, fp16, training, evaluation, and data configs via get_args
add_model_config_args: add model configuration arguments like hidden size, num layers, attention heads, and vocab size to an argparse parser
add_training_args: add training arguments like batch size, learning rate, weight decay, gradient clipping, and checkpointing to a parser
add_fp16_config_args: add mixed precision fp16 arguments including loss scaling, hysteresis, and fp32 fallback options to a parser
add_data_args: add data configuration arguments including train/valid/test data paths, tokenizer type, and sequence length to a parser
